cohort: 74 late preterm and term neonates with respiratory distress admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit at a tertiary care center
finding: This prospective study found that delivery by LSCS and male sex were risk factors for transient tachypnea of the newborn.
mod_finding: Delivery by LSCS was a risk factor for the development of TTN and was associated with a longer duration of distress and longer NICU stay.
